claimant_name.quote: Felix Brandt. My flight to Dublin on 7 March 2025 was cancelled by the airline because of storm Hanna and I could not travel. Airline notice and booking attached. I would like my money back.

incident_date.quote: Flight EW 9410 Frankfurt - Dublin on 2025-03-07 has been cancelled due to severe weather (storm Hanna).

affected.quote: Felix Brandt. My flight to Dublin on 7 March 2025 was cancelled by the airline because of storm Hanna and I could not travel. Airline notice and booking attached. I would like my money back.

prior_knowledge.rationale: Nothing indicates the claimant knew of the incident before purchase.

suspicious_documents.rationale: The documents are consistent with each other and show no alteration signs.

cancellation_reason.rationale: Weather is neither listed as a covered reason nor excluded; 'other specified personal emergencies' does not clearly include it.
cancellation_reason.review: Whether a storm that cancels the flight is an 'other specified personal emergency' is for an adjuster.
